scope.summary: Implement OS/clipboard handoff as commands: copy-as-CSS/SVG/PNG of a selection to the clipboard for cross-tool paste; open-in/edit-in round trips that stay within the ONE unified StudioDocument (no exporting between separate apps - raster/vector/layout are one document); and loading third-party raster filter plugins under the sandboxed plugin/consent contract (Section 7), never as ambient native code. Platform-exclusive OS integrations (OS photo-app extensions, pen/dial/tablet input) supported where the native shell provides the surface, otherwise out of scope, never a hosted/platform-locked runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: copy-as-CSS/SVG/PNG + in-document edit-in + sandboxed third-party filter loading
expected_tests: live: copy-as-SVG/PNG/CSS of a selection to clipboard
test: edit-in round trip stays within one StudioDocument (no external export)
negative: third-party raster filter loads only via sandboxed consent contract

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / OS & clipboard handoff (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Clipboard/OS handoff missing, or third-party filters run as ambient native code.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
